clarifications.question: Does P1 provide Shapley allocations?
clarifications.answer: No. It consumes supplied credits and replays utility observations only. P3 exact/sample/report are real TODOs.

clarifications.question: Is v(empty) always the baseline field?
clarifications.answer: No. Empty-required criteria also contribute; use actual empty coalition value.

clarifications.question: Are sampled estimates exact?
clarifications.answer: No. Completed full permutations give approximate per-player estimates and an exact telescoping total, with actual sample counts explicit.

clarifications.question: What are the team players?
clarifications.answer: Direct children of each Team; V(selected)=original primitive utility at selected children primitive union.

clarifications.question: Does UID dedup prove Sybil resistance?
clarifications.answer: No. This finite declared identity model does not authenticate real actors.

clarifications.question: Do receipts transfer funds?
clarifications.answer: No. Denominations and bids are synthetic exact data; no external payment or investment claim.
